title: Japanese-Style Chickpea Tagine
description: A fusion of Japanese and Algerian flavors, this dish combines chickpeas with a warm and savory sauce.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the ginger and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Add the chickpeas, soy sauce, sugar, and water.
Stir to combine, then bring to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and cook, covered, for 15-20 minutes.
Stir in the tagine and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with green onions.
